## Summary

A short, clear description of the feature you are requesting.

## Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve or what value does it add?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you have in mind. If you have code snippets or examples, include them here.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative approaches you considered and why you prefer the proposed solution.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references that may help clarify the request.
